passage.text: Starting from July 1, plastic bags will not be free in any university shop.
passage.reading: ˈstɑːrtɪŋ frəm dʒuˈlaɪ ˈfɜːrst, ˈplæstɪk ˈbæɡz wɪl ˈnɑːt bi ˈfriː ɪn ˈɛni ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈʃɑːp.

passage.text: This new rule is part of the university's campaign to reduce plastic waste.
passage.reading: ˈðɪs ˈnuː ˈruːl ɪz ˈpɑːrt əv ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz kæmˈpeɪn tə rɪˈduːs ˈplæstɪk ˈweɪst.

passage.text: Please bring your own bag when you go shopping.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ jʊr ˈoʊn ˈbæɡ wɛn juː ˈɡoʊ ˈʃɑːpɪŋ.

passage.text: The bookstore sells cloth bags for 59 baht.
passage.reading: ðə ˈbʊkstɔːr ˈsɛlz ˈklɔːθ ˈbæɡz fər ˈfɪfti ˈnaɪn ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: If you forget your bag, shops will sell you a plastic bag for 2 baht.
passage.reading: ɪf juː fərˈɡɛt jʊr ˈbæɡ, ˈʃɑːps wɪl ˈsɛl juː ə ˈplæstɪk ˈbæɡ fər ˈtuː ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: All money from these bags will be used to plant trees around the university.
passage.reading: ˈɔːl ˈmʌni frəm ˈðiːz ˈbæɡz wɪl bi ˈjuːzd tə ˈplænt ˈtriːz əˈraʊnd ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: Students are also encouraged to use reusable bottles and cups.
passage.reading: ˈstuːdənts ər ˈɔːlsoʊ ɪnˈkɜːrɪdʒd tə ˈjuːz ˌriːˈjuːzəbəl ˈbɑːtəlz ənd ˈkʌps.

passage.text: Free drinking water is available in every building.
passage.reading: ˈfriː ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ˈwɔːtər ɪz əˈveɪləbəl ɪn ˈɛvri ˈbɪldɪŋ.

passage.text: Customers who bring their own cup will receive 5 baht off any drink at the café.
passage.reading: ˈkʌstəmərz huː ˈbrɪŋ ðɛr ˈoʊn ˈkʌp wɪl rɪˈsiːv ˈfaɪv ˈbɑːt ˈɔːf ˈɛni ˈdrɪŋk ət ðə kæˈfeɪ.

passage.text: If you have any questions, please visit the student center.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz, ˈpliːz ˈvɪzɪt ðə ˈstuːdənt ˌsɛntər.

passage.text: Thank you for helping us protect the environment.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈhɛlpɪŋ ʌs prəˈtɛkt ði ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt.
